name: MeUp WF-10 (Postgres) · Conciliación de egresos generales (Contabilidad)

parameters.query:
select id_doc as "ID_DOC", fecha_recibido as "FECHA_RECIBIDO", remitente_wa as "REMITENTE_WA",
       ocr_valor as "OCR_VALOR", ocr_fecha_pago as "OCR_FECHA_PAGO", ocr_cliente as "OCR_CLIENTE",
       ocr_referencia as "OCR_REFERENCIA", ocr_cuenta_destino as "OCR_CUENTA_DESTINO",
       categoria_gasto as "CATEGORIA_GASTO", oc_num as "OC_NUM",
       id_compra_informado as "ID_COMPRA_INFORMADO", url_drive as "URL_DRIVE", estado as "ESTADO",
       exists (select 1 from pagos_oc po where po.id_doc_wa = comprobantes_wa.id_doc) as "PAGO_REGISTRADO",
       (select po.id_control from pagos_oc po where po.id_doc_wa = comprobantes_wa.id_doc) as "PAGO_ID_CONTROL"
from comprobantes_wa
where clasificacion = 'COMPROBANTE_EGRESO' and grupo_origen = 'CONTABILIDAD'
  and estado in ('PROCESADO','SIN_MATCH');

select id_mov as "ID_MOV", fecha as "FECHA", cuenta as "CUENTA", valor as "VALOR", tipo as "TIPO",
       categoria as "CATEGORIA", detalle as "DETALLE", factura_oc as "FACTURA_OC", tercero as "TERCERO",
       referencia as "REFERENCIA", descripcion as "DESCRIPCION", id_conciliacion as "ID_CONCILIACION", origen as "ORIGEN"
from bancos_mov;

select id_control as "ID_CONTROL", id_compra as "ID_COMPRA", nit_proveedor as "NIT_PROVEEDOR",
       proveedor_nombre as "PROVEEDOR_NOMBRE", valor_costo as "VALOR_COSTO", estado_pago as "ESTADO_PAGO",
       oc_total_pagar as "OC_TOTAL_PAGAR", valor_pagado as "VALOR_PAGADO"
from proveedores_locales_pagos;

select id_doc as "ID_DOC", fecha_recibido as "FECHA_RECIBIDO", remitente_wa as "REMITENTE_WA",
       ocr_valor as "OCR_VALOR", ocr_cliente as "OCR_CLIENTE", oc_num as "OC_NUM",
       clasificacion as "CLASIFICACION", categoria_gasto as "CATEGORIA_GASTO", estado as "ESTADO"
from comprobantes_wa
where clasificacion in ('FACTURA','ORDEN_COMPRA') and estado in ('REVISAR','ARCHIVO','PROCESADO');

parameters.query:
insert into pagos_oc (id_control, id_compra, nit_proveedor, valor, fecha_pago, fuente, id_doc_wa, id_mov_banco, notas)
values ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::numeric, nullif($5::text,'')::date, 'AMBOS', $6::text, $7::text, $8::text)
on conflict (id_doc_wa) where id_doc_wa is not null
do update set id_mov_banco = excluded.id_mov_banco, fuente = 'AMBOS', notas = excluded.notas, updated_at = now();

' (abono)' : '')) ] }}

parameters.query:
update comprobantes_wa set estado = $2::text, notas = $3::text, updated_at = now()
where id_doc = $1::text;

with oc as (
  select distinct on (c.oc_num, c.ocr_nit_proveedor) c.id_doc, c.oc_num, c.ocr_nit_proveedor, c.ocr_valor,
         c.ocr_subtotal, c.ocr_iva, c.ocr_rete_fuente, c.ocr_rete_ica, c.oc_formato, c.oc_version
  from comprobantes_wa c
  where c.clasificacion = 'ORDEN_COMPRA' and c.oc_num is not null and c.ocr_valor is not null
  order by c.oc_num, c.ocr_nit_proveedor, c.fecha_recibido desc
), u as (
  update proveedores_locales_pagos p set
    oc_id_doc = oc.id_doc, oc_formato = oc.oc_formato, oc_version = oc.oc_version,
    oc_subtotal = oc.ocr_subtotal, oc_iva = oc.ocr_iva, oc_rete_fuente = oc.ocr_rete_fuente,
    oc_rete_ica = oc.ocr_rete_ica, oc_total_pagar = oc.ocr_valor,
    estado_pago = case when p.valor_pagado <= 0 then p.estado_pago
                       when p.valor_pagado >= oc.ocr_valor - 1 then 'PAGADO' else 'ABONADO' end
  from oc
  where p.id_compra = oc.oc_num
    and ( (oc.ocr_nit_proveedor is not null and oc.ocr_nit_proveedor = p.nit_proveedor)
       or (oc.ocr_nit_proveedor is null and (select count(*) from proveedores_locales_pagos x where x.id_compra = oc.oc_num) = 1) )
    and p.oc_id_doc is distinct from oc.id_doc
  returning p.id_control
)
select count(*) as ocs_aplicadas from u;
